classification: read-only offline evidence capture; no flight decision

payload.receipt_metadata: JSONL, keyed by topic/source stamp/frame and receipt monotonic ns

identity.source: run manifest + runtime-contract.json + session manifest + live NavigationCommand and MapStatus

capture_window.start: before flight task submission and before prestream
capture_window.end: verified safe session terminal plus 3 wall seconds, or bounded observer timeout

capacity_planning.basis: Worst-case uncompressed camera payload plus bounded IMU/message allowance, 700 simulated seconds and 25% reserve. Zstd can reduce size but no compression ratio is assumed. Receipt queues are independently bounded and observational.

missing_data: Record the error and report INSUFFICIENT offline; recorder state must not refuse, cancel, pause, or land a task.
